title: #176 The Illiterates
prompt: The illiterates of the 21st century will not be those who cannot read and write, but those who cannot learn, unlearn, and relearn. Agree or Disagree?

promptSegments.text: The illiterates of the 21st century will not be those who cannot read and write, but those who cannot learn, unlearn, and relearn.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point is that illiterates in the 21st century are those who cannot learn new things, meaning people must be able to adapt their knowledge as times change.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point is that illiterates in the 21st century are those who cannot learn new things, meaning people must be able to adapt their knowledge as times change.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point emphasizes the necessity of unlearning old ideas, as outdated knowledge can prevent people from adopting better methods and achieving progress.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point emphasizes the necessity of unlearning old ideas, as outdated knowledge can prevent people from adopting better methods and achieving progress.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The illiterates of the modern world are those who cannot adapt to change, not just those who cannot read or write.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The illiterates of the modern world are those who cannot adapt to change, not just those who cannot read or write.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Staying current with knowledge and skills is necessary for people to live well in a rapidly changing world.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Staying current with knowledge and skills is necessary for people to live well in a rapidly changing world.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that continuous learning is essential for success in the modern job market.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that continuous learning is essential for success in the modern job market.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point argues that the ability to unlearn old ideas is necessary for adapting to technological and societal changes.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point argues that the ability to unlearn old ideas is necessary for adapting to technological and societal changes.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The core argument is that modern illiteracy is not defined by the inability to read or write, but by the lack of adaptability and continuous learning skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The core argument is that modern illiteracy is not defined by the inability to read or write, but by the lack of adaptability and continuous learning skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay supports this by arguing that practical skills are more important than basic literacy, and that continuous learning is necessary because the job market changes rapidly.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay supports this by arguing that practical skills are more important than basic literacy, and that continuous learning is necessary because the job market changes rapidly.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
